verses.1: And Yehoshua arrived there in the morning. They left from the camp and went all the way to the Jordan River. All of Israel’s people gathered there, and they rested there before continuing their journey.
verses.2: And it was three days before the soldiers passed by the camp.
verses.3: And he commanded the people, “See how the priests of the covenant of the LORD your God are carrying it. Go also and follow them from your places of residence.”
verses.4: But it will be far away among you and among him. It’s like thousands of miles apart. Do not approach him, so that you may know the path you must take. For you have not yet crossed the path that leads to salvation.
verses.5: And Joshua said to the people, “Be holy, for the day of the Lord will come soon, and He will do wonderful things among you.”
verses.6: And Joshua said to the priests, “Take the Ark of the Covenant and carry it before the people.” So they took the Ark of the Covenant and went before the people.
verses.7: And the LORD said to Joshua, “Today I will make you great in the eyes of all Israel. They will know that just as I was with Moses, so also I will be with you.”
verses.8: And you shall command the priests, the ministers of the covenant, to say, “As you go along along the banks of the Jordan, stand there.”
verses.9: And Joshua said to the children of Israel, “Go now, and listen to the words of the LORD your God.”
verses.10: And Joshua said, “Know this: The Lord is among you. He will take away from you the Canaanites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivvites, and Girgashites.”
verses.11: Look, the sign of the covenant is before you on the Jordan River.
verses.12: And now, take twelve men from the tribes of Israel. One man for each tribe.
verses.13: And it shall be that the feet of the priests, who carry the Ark of the LORD, will carry the entire world across the Jordan River. The waters that flow from above will carry them across the river, and they will stand together.
verses.14: And during their journey from their camps, they crossed the Jordan River. The priests, who were the ones who carried the Ark of the Covenant, stood before the people.
verses.15: And as the carriers of the grain carried them to the river, and the feet of the priests also carried the grain. They were sprinkled with water at the edges of the river. The river was filled with all kinds of grains during the days of harvesting.
verses.16: And the waters that came from above stood still. They were far away from the city, which was located on the side of Zaratna. These waters rushed down onto the salty sea. The people crossed over in that direction.
verses.17: And the priests, who carried the offerings, stood before the covenant of Jehovah in the valley. All of Israel also passed through that valley until all the nations had crossed the Jordan River.
